package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"log/slog"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/config"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
	aipromptclient "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/http/aiprompt"
	courseclient "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/http/course"
	studentclient "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/http/student"
	tzplannerclient "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/http/tzplanner"
	natspublisher "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/messaging/nats"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	transporthttp "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http"
	apihandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	privatehandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	diagnosticmessages "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/message/nats"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/courseplan"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/diagnosticplan"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/hybridreplan"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/onboardinghandoff"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/onboardingpathexecution"
	outboxuc "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/outbox"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/pedagogy"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/practiceroute"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/projectauthoring"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/readiness"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/targetcatalog"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

type uuidGenerator struct{}

func (uuidGenerator) NewID() string { return uuid.NewString() }

type systemClock struct{}

func (systemClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Now().UTC() }

func main() {
	logger := slog.New(slog.NewJSONHandler(os.Stdout, nil))
	if err := run(logger); err != nil {
		logger.Error("service stopped", "error", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func run(logger *slog.Logger) error {
	serviceConfig, err := config.Load()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	rootContext, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()

	pool, err := pgxpool.New(rootContext, serviceConfig.DatabaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	pingContext, cancelPing := context.WithTimeout(rootContext, 5*time.Second)
	defer cancelPing()
	if err := pool.Ping(pingContext); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	store := postgres.Store{Pool: pool}
	client := &http.Client{Timeout: serviceConfig.DownstreamHTTPTimeout}
	studentService := studentclient.Client{
		BaseURL: serviceConfig.StudentServiceURL, ReadToken: serviceConfig.StudentServiceToken,
		WriteToken: serviceConfig.StudentServiceWriteToken, HTTPClient: client,
	}
	courseService := courseclient.Client{
		BaseURL: serviceConfig.CourseServiceURL, InternalToken: serviceConfig.CourseServiceToken,
		DiagnosticCatalogToken: serviceConfig.CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken, HTTPClient: client,
	}
	contentGenerator := aipromptclient.Client{
		BaseURL: serviceConfig.AIPromptServiceURL, InternalToken: serviceConfig.AIPromptServiceToken,
		HTTPClient: client,
	}
	tzPlannerService := tzplannerclient.Client{
		BaseURL: serviceConfig.TZPlannerServiceURL, InternalToken: serviceConfig.TZPlannerServiceToken,
		HTTPClient: &http.Client{Timeout: serviceConfig.ProjectAuthoringHTTPTimeout},
	}
	ids := uuidGenerator{}
	clock := systemClock{}
	placementConsumer := diagnosticplan.PlacementConsumer{Plans: store, Placements: store, Students: studentService, Clock: clock}
	diagnosticConsumer, err := diagnosticmessages.NewDiagnosticResultConsumer(rootContext, serviceConfig.NATSURL, placementConsumer)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer diagnosticConsumer.Close()
	planningStateConsumer, err := diagnosticmessages.NewPlanningStateConsumer(rootContext, serviceConfig.NATSURL, hybridreplan.TriggerProcessor{Jobs: store})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer planningStateConsumer.Close()
	go hybridreplan.SnapshotWorker{
		Processor: hybridreplan.SnapshotProcessor{Jobs: store, Students: studentService, Clock: clock,
			LeaseTTL: serviceConfig.WorkerLeaseTTL, RetryDelay: 2 * time.Second},
		PollInterval: serviceConfig.WorkerPollInterval, Logger: logger,
	}.Run(rootContext)
	go hybridreplan.EvaluationWorker{
		Processor: hybridreplan.EvaluationProcessor{Consequences: store, Policies: store, Graphs: store, Clock: clock,
			LeaseTTL: serviceConfig.WorkerLeaseTTL, RetryDelay: 2 * time.Second},
		PollInterval: serviceConfig.WorkerPollInterval, Logger: logger,
	}.Run(rootContext)
	go hybridreplan.ApplicationWorker{
		Processor: hybridreplan.ApplicationProcessor{Applications: store, Students: studentService, Clock: clock,
			LeaseTTL: serviceConfig.WorkerLeaseTTL, RetryDelay: 2 * time.Second},
		PollInterval: serviceConfig.WorkerPollInterval, Logger: logger,
	}.Run(rootContext)
	eventPublisher := &natspublisher.Publisher{
		URL: serviceConfig.NATSURL, Name: "ms-go-learning-planner-outbox",
		ConnectTimeout: serviceConfig.OutboxPublishTimeout,
	}
	defer eventPublisher.Close()
	relay := outboxuc.Relay{
		Outbox: store, Publisher: eventPublisher, Clock: clock,
		WorkerID: "learning-planner-" + uuid.NewString(), BatchSize: serviceConfig.OutboxBatchSize,
		LockTTL: serviceConfig.OutboxLockTTL, PublishTimeout: serviceConfig.OutboxPublishTimeout,
		RetryBase: serviceConfig.OutboxRetryBase, RetryMax: serviceConfig.OutboxRetryMax,
	}
	go runOutboxRelay(rootContext, logger, relay, serviceConfig.OutboxPollInterval)
	createCoursePlan := courseplan.Create{Requests: store, DiagnosticRequests: store, IDs: ids, Clock: clock}
	readinessResolver := readiness.Resolver{Enabled: serviceConfig.GraphReadinessEnabled, Students: studentService, Graphs: store}
	acceptOnboardingHandoff := onboardinghandoff.Acceptor{
		Enabled: serviceConfig.OnboardingHandoffEnabled, Receipts: store, Readiness: readinessResolver, IDs: ids, Clock: clock,
	}
	getCoursePlan := courseplan.Get{Requests: store}
	processor := courseplan.Processor{
		Requests: store, Graphs: store, Policies: store, Students: studentService, Courses: courseService,
		Generator: contentGenerator,
		IDs:       ids, Clock: clock, Strategies: pedagogy.NewDefaultRegistry(),
		LeaseTTL: serviceConfig.WorkerLeaseTTL, MaxAttempts: serviceConfig.WorkerMaxAttempts,
		DiagnosticPlans: store, DiagnosticPlacements: store,
		InitialAllocations: store,
	}
	worker := courseplan.Worker{
		Processor: processor, PollInterval: serviceConfig.WorkerPollInterval, Logger: logger,
	}
	go worker.Run(rootContext)
	// S9 remains inert unless the separately validated execution gate is on.
	// Construction is schema-safe: no S9 repository call happens while off.
	if serviceConfig.OnboardingPathExecutionEnabled {
		s9processor := onboardingpathexecution.Processor{
			Enabled: true, Executions: store, Graphs: store, Policies: store,
			Readiness: studentService, Students: studentService, Courses: courseService, Generator: contentGenerator,
			IDs: ids, Clock: clock, Strategies: pedagogy.NewDefaultRegistry(), LeaseTTL: serviceConfig.WorkerLeaseTTL, MaxAttempts: serviceConfig.WorkerMaxAttempts,
		}
		go onboardingpathexecution.Worker{Processor: s9processor, PollInterval: serviceConfig.WorkerPollInterval, Logger: logger}.Run(rootContext)
	}
	projectCommands := projectauthoring.Commands{Flows: store, Students: studentService, IDs: ids, Clock: clock}
	projectWorker := projectauthoring.Worker{Processor: projectauthoring.Processor{
		Flows: store, Students: studentService, TZ: tzPlannerService, IDs: ids, Clock: clock,
		LeaseTTL: serviceConfig.ProjectAuthoringLeaseTTL, MaxAttempts: serviceConfig.ProjectAuthoringMaxAttempts,
	}, PollInterval: serviceConfig.WorkerPollInterval, Logger: logger}
	go projectWorker.Run(rootContext)

	handler := transporthttp.NewRouter(transporthttp.RouterDependencies{
		CoursePlans:        apihandlers.CoursePlanHandler{Create: createCoursePlan, Get: getCoursePlan},
		TeacherCoursePlans: privatehandlers.CoursePlanHandler{Create: createCoursePlan, DiagnosticState: courseplan.GetDiagnosticPlanning{Plans: store, Requests: store}},
		Health:             privatehandlers.HealthHandler{Checker: pool}, InternalToken: serviceConfig.InternalAPIToken,
		TargetCatalog: privatehandlers.TargetCatalogHandler{Resolve: targetcatalog.Resolve{Catalog: store}, Discover: targetcatalog.Discover{Catalog: store}},
		PracticeLearning: privatehandlers.PracticeLearningHandler{
			Routes:    newPracticeLearningResolver(store, studentService, clock),
			Materials: practiceroute.Materializer{Routes: store, Catalog: store, Generator: contentGenerator, Courses: courseService},
		},
		LearningReadiness:     privatehandlers.LearningReadinessHandler{Resolve: readinessResolver},
		OnboardingPlanHandoff: privatehandlers.OnboardingPlanHandoffHandler{Accept: acceptOnboardingHandoff},
		TeacherToken:          serviceConfig.TeacherServiceToken, TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken: serviceConfig.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken,
		PracticeToken:       serviceConfig.PracticeServiceToken,
		DiagnosticBootstrap: apihandlers.DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapHandler{Bootstrap: diagnosticplan.Bootstrap{Issuer: diagnosticplan.Issuer{Plans: store, Reservations: store, Placements: store, Courses: courseService, Students: studentService, Clock: clock}, Plans: store, Receipts: store, Students: studentService, Clock: clock}},
		DiagnosticPlacement: privatehandlers.DiagnosticPlacementHandler{Placement: placementConsumer},
		ProjectAuthoring:    privatehandlers.ProjectAuthoringHandler{Commands: projectCommands},
	})
	server := &http.Server{
		Addr: serviceConfig.HTTPAddr, Handler: handler,
		ReadHeaderTimeout: 5 * time.Second, ReadTimeout: 15 * time.Second,
		WriteTimeout: 15 * time.Second, IdleTimeout: 60 * time.Second,
	}
	serverErrors := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		logger.Info("service started", "address", serviceConfig.HTTPAddr)
		serverErrors <- server.ListenAndServe()
	}()

	select {
	case <-rootContext.Done():
	case err := <-serverErrors:
		if !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
			return err
		}
	}
	shutdownContext, cancelShutdown := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancelShutdown()
	if err := server.Shutdown(shutdownContext); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func newPracticeLearningResolver(store postgres.Store, students domainservice.PracticeStudentMasteryService, clock practiceroute.Clock) practiceroute.Resolver {
	return practiceroute.Resolver{
		Routes: store, Readiness: store, Catalog: store, Students: students, Policies: store,
		Strategies: pedagogy.NewDefaultRegistry(), Clock: clock,
	}
}

func runOutboxRelay(ctx context.Context, logger *slog.Logger, relay outboxuc.Relay, interval time.Duration) {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		if _, err := relay.ProcessBatch(ctx); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
			logger.Error("outbox relay failed", "error", err)
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}
